statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = n - k + 1 and for every integer i with 0 <= i < n - k + 1, r[i] is the power of the subarray nums[i..i+k-1]: if for every j with i <= j < i+k-1 we have nums[j+1] = nums[j] + 1, then r[i] = nums[i+k-1]; otherwise r[i] = -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). 1 <= n <= 10^5; 1 <= k <= n; for every j with 0 <= j < n, 1 <= nums[j] <= 10^6.
